definitions.realised_net: incremental margin (recommendation_evaluations.margin_impact: (sold - expected) x (price - cost)) minus the holding cost incurred
definitions.holding_cost_incurred: the engine's holding_cost_if_unsold x units_unsold / suggested_order_qty - an approximation, stated on each row
definitions.units_unsold: recommended units not sold inside the window (recommended_qty - units_sold, floored at 0); a count against the order, not a shelf count
definitions.window: the 30-day window where closed, else the longest closed window; closed means the evaluator's data_through has passed rec_date + window
definitions.lost_money: closed window, fulfilment confirmed, net < 0 (or incremental margin < 0 with holding cost unknown: a loss of at least that much)
definitions.exposure_unconfirmed: closed window with a net, but fulfilment pending / claimed / unobservable: not attributed as gain or loss
definitions.not_followed_no_exposure: fulfilment not_followed or expired: nothing was bought, so no money was at risk
definitions.unmeasurable: closed window but no net can be computed: the reason names the missing input (cost, lift, unsold capture, holding figure)
definitions.ci95: date-clustered bootstrap over decision dates, 2000 draws, seeded; needs 10 cards on 2 dates
definitions.duplicate_of: a later card for the same SKU on the same day reading the same window: listed with its own verdict, but its dollars are counted once, under the first card
definitions.lost_money_meaning: a confirmed restock after which the product sold BELOW its own baseline (negative incremental margin), plus the holding cost of the units left - deferred revenue on spirits, not destroyed stock; the engine's holding model prices that
